maker: Obayashi Corporation, Aktio and Sakai Denki
model: ストローダー® (semi-automatic low-floor heavy-load carrier)
name: Obayashi / Aktio ストローダー heavy-load carrier
summary: Flat, 270 kg 'semi-automatic robot' carrier on mecanum wheels that drives under a loaded trolley, jacks it up and moves up to 1 t in any direction, steered by one worker with a gamepad remote. Developed by the Japanese contractor Obayashi and rented by Aktio for construction sites, factories and warehouses since July 2025.

germany.statusNote: Rented in Japan by the construction equipment rental firm Aktio from 1 July 2025; no sale, rental or partner outside Japan found.

specs.quote: ゲームパッドを採用した無線コントローラーを使用するため、フォークリフト等の運転資格がなくても簡単に操作が行えます

notes: Remote-controlled by a worker, not autonomous; the makers call it a semi-automatic robot.
Mecanum wheels let it drive sideways, diagonally and turn on the spot in narrow aisles; steps up to 20 mm and slopes up to 6°, so it needs fairly level floors.
Drives under a loaded trolley and jacks it up, so loads need not be transferred.
